Container.Name: chowkidar
Container.Overview: Lightweight Docker health monitor with auto-heal actions and multi-provider notifications. Watches container health events and reacts with configurable actions (restart, stop, run-script, webhook, auto-heal). Supports Discord, Slack, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, email, and plain Apprise URLs.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — required for container monitoring and actions.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Application log level: debug (most verbose) / info / warn / error. Use 'debug' for full verbose output.
